english.title: Cab owner / person holding cab licence failed to deliver licence and plates within specified period
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[owner of a cab, namely **(..SPECIFY CAB..),]_
(B)_[person holding the licence in respect of a cab, namely **(..SPECIFY CAB..) on behalf of the firm or company which owned it,]_

failed to, not later than three days after **(..SPECIFY DATE OF LICENCE EXPIRATION..), the expiration of the period for which the licence in respect of the cab was granted, deliver up the licence and the plates affixed to the cab in pursuance of the London Cab Order 1934 to Transport for London or a Public Carriage Examiner
english.legislation: Contrary to Article 21 of the London Cab Order 1934 and section 10 of the Metropolitan Carriage Act 1869.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
